outputs.explanation: This is a macroscopic photograph of intestines, not a plot showing averaged data.
This is a histological micrograph (H&E staining), not a plot showing averaged data.

Panel C contains a box plot (top, exempt as it already shows distribution) and a 3D bar chart (bottom) showing mean polyp numbers per mouse across genotypes and diameter categories (n=8–18 per genotype). The bar chart represents averaged data across many animals but shows no overlaid individual data points.
This is a Kaplan-Meier survival line plot, a plot type exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

Panel E includes a western blot pulldown assay and a bar chart quantifying the relative GTP-bound Rac1 and Cdc42 levels with error bars. This bar chart represents averaged data but does not show the individual data points behind the means.
This panel shows immunohistochemistry micrographs, not a plot showing averaged data.

Panel G includes immunoblots/zymography and a bar chart of relative expression (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) with error bars and significance markers, indicating averaged data across replicates, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
